svg.title: The Sub-$1,000 Launch Sequence
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-lean-launch-sequence; chapter number: 1; chart type: process_flow; title: The Sub-$1,000 Launch Sequence; subtitle: Spend on the phone first, buy insurance and supplies only when a deal closes; caption: AJ Simmons sequences a lean launch around a $99 CBN membership, a $200 LLC budget, a $25 domain and 400 cold calls in week one, deferring insurance and supplies until a contract is ready to close.; assumptions note: Step order follows AJ Simmons's launch plan and operator gates. Dollar figures and call counts are his attributed claims; funnel yields are his ranges, not guarantees.; note: Source AJ SIMMONS (VrlDbQP4iQI at 00:14:20, 00:15:12, 00:16:03; QBuGc_Q36dg at 00:05:39; mk-8avM72Ms at 00:02:52).; stages: step: 01; label: Lean launch kit; value: Step 1; detail: $99 CBN membership, $200 LLC budget and a $25 domain; no supplies bought yet.; step: 02; label: 400 calls in week one; value: Step 2; detail: Call 100 businesses Monday through Friday; 400 calls yield 1-4 walkthroughs.; step: 03; label: Measure cleanable footage; value: Step 3; detail: Laser-measure only cleanable square footage; bidding the whole building sends the price too high.; step: 04; label: Proposal within 2-3 hours; value: Step 4; detail: Slow turnaround turns the walkthrough into wasted time.; step: 05; label: Close, then insure and stock; value: Step 5; detail: Buy the quoted policy and supplies at close; push upfront payment, otherwise net 10 or net 15.
